Perfect
Jul 2025 • Family
Maison des Rêves Saigon by Chef Thao Na
I was first introduced to the charming and incredibly talented Chef Thảo Nhà a few years ago through another of my favorite chefs — and ever since, her food has left a lasting impression. Her newest creation, Maison des Rêves, is nothing short of magical.

Our evening began with not one, but three amuse-bouches — each delicate, creative, and a perfect palate teaser. These small bites truly set the tone and elevated the entire meal from the very start. The potato soup was silky and comforting, while the crispy ham bite delivered a satisfying burst of flavor and texture.

The bread basket was a standout — especially the cheese straws, hot and freshly baked with the perfect crunch. It’s rare to see this level of care in what’s often an overlooked part of the meal.

We opted for à la carte rather than the degustation menu, which they do offer. After a previous attempt at a multi-course meal elsewhere left us feeling overwhelmed, we appreciated that Maison des Rêves lets you choose your own pace. And honestly, our selected dishes felt just right — indulgent but never too much.

The chicken stuffed with lobster was both elegant and satisfying, and the steak and lamb rack were cooked beautifully — tender, flavorful, and well-balanced.

Since we were celebrating a special birthday, we were treated to a divine birthday tiramisu, and the two dessert plates brought out for the kids were just as impressive. The little touches — from the tiramisu to the mini brownie that disappeared in seconds — made the experience feel both personal and elevated.

Chef Thảo Nhà is not only a gifted chef — she’s also gracious, warm, and brings a sense of joy to the table through her food. Maison des Rêves is truly worth venturing out of the Thảo Điền bubble for. We’ll be back — and next time, we just might be ready for that degustation.

Beautiful French Cuisine at Maison des Reves
Dec 2023 • Couples
Chef Thao Na has returned to her original location with another French inspired concept - Maison Des Rêves - described as “bistronomy”; a gastronomic, casual fine dining experience styled as a bistro. 
• For those who loved Atelier des Reves this feels like a reboot, "Reves 2:0" with a stripped back, comfortable décor and a key focus on French techniques & flavours. 
• Degustation & A la carte menu’s are offered and we opted for the tasting option which has an interesting twist as the guest chooses their dessert option from the main carte. 
Especially 💜

🐮 Angus Beef with Truffle Sauce
🍍 Pineapple Brulee with Coconut IceCream

Must try relaxed fine bistro dining in the heart of Saigon
Dec 2023 • Friends
One of my favourite restaurants in Saigon has recently reopened. If you are a food lover this is a "must try" dining experience. Not only do they serve excellent quality dishes at a very reasonable price but the attention to detail in every part of the service is extraordinary. 4 of us ordered a variety of dishes from the menu and every dish was designed with contrasting and complimentary flavours, textures and colours. There is a well-constructed and reasonably priced wine list and the design and ambience of the restaurant is relaxed bistro to allow you to focus on enjoying the excellent food that you are served. We will be back ...... regularly!
